summary.name: SWE-agent
summary.one_liner: SWE-agent is an open-source agent that lets a language model use tools to autonomously fix issues in real GitHub repositories, though it is now in maintenance-only mode and superseded by mini-swe-agent.
use_cases: fixing issues in GitHub repositories automatically
running custom tasks with an LM agent
summary.what_it_does:
SWE-agent lets a language model of choice, such as GPT-4o or Claude Sonnet 4, autonomously use tools to resolve issues in real GitHub repositories, find cybersecurity vulnerabilities, or perform other custom tasks. The agent is configured through a single YAML file and is described as simple and hackable for research. The page reports state-of-the-art results on SWE-bench among open-source projects, and news items mention SWE-agent 1.0 with Claude 3.7, SWE-agent-LM-32b, and multimodal support for images in GitHub issues. It is built and maintained by researchers from Princeton University and Stanford University. The page now directs users to mini-swe-agent, which the authors say matches SWE-agent's performance while being simpler.</what_it_does>
